[1/1] Add committed REUSE metadata to the existing licenses/ directory

impact_assessment.why: The project's legal texts live in licenses/; the Windows checkout cannot also create LICENSES/ without a case collision, so the REUSE metadata was never committed.
impact_assessment.benefits: A scanner can resolve LicenseRef-AL-1.1 from the tracked tree without renaming historical paths or adding a second directory.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: generated path stays under licenses/ for this project; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no runtime state.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use the fixed AIKit directory picker, update the SPDX policy and README tree, and run the project's four gates.

[1/2] Bound untrusted JSON; [2/2] hash the serialized certificate payload

impact_assessment.why: Certificate, register and registry loaders parsed unbounded JSON, and issuance hashed a pre-DTO dict that could diverge from the saved dataclass payload when a future default is added.
impact_assessment.benefits: Memory bombs fail before parsing, and the bytes that are saved are the bytes that are signed.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new parse limits and exact-payload hashing; dependency: none; concurrency: read-only loaders; state: no schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Bounded loader with byte/depth/node tests, route register/verifier/registry through it, and pin the serialized-payload digest with a regression test.

[1/1] Reject rendered markup and fingerprint the verification ruleset

impact_assessment.why: Free-form certificate fields reached Markdown/HTML renderers without a parsed-value ban, and results did not record which rules produced them.
impact_assessment.benefits: Unsafe metadata fails at admission and results from different rule profiles cannot be compared as if identical.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: stricter cert_from_dict validation and a new result field; dependency: none; concurrency: read-only verification; state: no schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate rendered fields in cert_from_dict, keep renderer escaping, add a declarative fingerprint/compare API, and pin both with unit tests.
